power.neoorigins.sporeling_mushroom_buff: Waxay soo cusboonaysiisaa caafimaadka inta lagu jiro biomes-ka likaha.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_fungal_contac: Waxay bogsiisaa 1 HP ilbiriqsi kasta marka aad dul taagan tahay ama gudaha boqoshaada ama mycelium.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_natural_armor: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - korriinka fangas ee adag ayaa jilcisa dharbaaxo kasta.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_daylight_dama: Waxay qaadataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_slow_movement: U dhaqaaqo 10% ka hooseeya sidii caadiga ahayd.
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Dhaxan
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.description: Qayb ka mid ah baraf iyo qabow - waxay qaboojisaa cadawga, waxay ku koraan taigas, laakiin dabka iyo Nether waa ba'an.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_aura.d: Wuxuu qarxiyaa cadawga u dhow oo leh gaabis xad dhaaf ah. Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 adkeysi10-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_cold_buff.des: Wuxuu helayaa xoog marka uu ku jiro qabow taiga biomes.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_fire_weakness: Waxay qaadataa labanlaab dhaawac ka yimaada dabka.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.name: Socodka Barafka
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.desc: Meelo baraf ku yaal block aad eegayso.1-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_natural_armor: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - baraf la kariyey ayaa leexiya dharbaaxo kasta.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_nether_damage: Waxay qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta uu Nether ku sugan yahay.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_immuni: Si buuxda uga difaaca dhaawaca barafowga.
origins.neoorigins.strider.name: Studiyaha
origins.neoorigins.strider.description: Makhluuqa wadaniga ah ee ku dul socda lafaha oo ku bogsada diirimaadka - laakiin qabowga dushiisa iyo biyuhu waa curyaan.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: Ka difaaca dabka, lava, magma blocks, iyo gubashada.
power.neoorigins.strider_nether_buff.des: Waxay helaysaa xawli kor u kaca inta uu Netherka joogo.
Waxay qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta lagu jiro biyo ama roob.
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.name: Soo kabashada Magma
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.desc: Waxay bogsiisaa 2 HP ilbiriqsikii marka lagu quusiyo lafaha.
power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Wuxuu si cad wax ugu arki karaa gudcur dhammaystiran. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Iska caabbinta Joogtada ah I - maqaarka adag ee magma-adag ayaa meesha ka saaraysa saamaynta.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Seeri
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: Saaxir badeed ku dhashay badweynta bannaan - waxay soo jiidataa xayawaannada soo jiidashada leh oo ku bogsada hirarka, laakiin tabar daran, gaabis ah, oo ku engegan dhulka.
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.name: Joogitaanka Soo jiidashada leh
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Dhammaan mooryaanta oo dhami way ku indho-tiraan haddii aanad marka hore soo weerarin.
power.neoorigins.siren_water_breathing.d: Neefsashada biyaha hoostooda si aan xad lahayn oo si cad wax uga dhex arkaya biyaha iyada oo aan ceeryaamo lahayn.
power.neoorigins.siren_aquatic_speed.des: Dabbaasha aad uga dheereeya ciyaartoyga caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.name: Indhaha Badweynta
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.desc: Waxay si cad u arki kartaa moolka mugdiga ah. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.siren_reduced_health.de: -2 wadnaha (-4 max HP). Caato ah, hees-lagu dhisay - aan loo samayn dharbaaxo.
power.neoorigins.siren_regen_in_water.de: Waxay bogsiisaa 1 HP ilbiriqsikii marka aad biyaha ku jirto.
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Wuu qallalaa
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.descrip: Hawadu way soo dhacaysaa marka aad biyo ka maqan tahay: oogada aad bay u dheer tahay oo waad ku neef qabataa. Roobka, digsi-biyoodka, Neefsashada biyaha ama marin-biyoodka firfircoon ee u dhow ayaa dhammaan demiya.
origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Piglin
origins.neoorigins.piglin.description: Dagaalyahan Nether ah oo dahab-ku-noqod ah - xoog ku leh guriga, oo ay ka cabsadaan qaraabadooda, laakiin daciifay meel ka baxsan Netherka.
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Nether Cadho
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.desc: Helay Awood II inta lagu jiro Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_gold_affinity.de: Piglins iyo Piglin Brutes kuma weerari doonaan.
power.neoorigins.piglin_fire_immunity.de: Ka difaaca dabka, lava, magma blocks, iyo dhammaan burburka gubanaya.
power.neoorigins.piglin_attack_bonus.des: Waxay fulisaa 2 dhaawac dheeraad ah garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.piglin_overworld_weakne: La il daran Tabar-dari inta ay ku sugan tahay dunida guudkeeda.
power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Si cad wax u arki kara gudcurka dhexdiisa. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.piglin_soul_fire_damage: Dabka nafta ayaa si qoto dheer u gubanaya - wuxuu qaataa 0.5 dhaawac ilbiriqsi kasta inta uu ku sugan yahay Dooxada Ciidda Soul.
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Hiil
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.description: Cayayaanka u eg shinnida oo si xor ah u duula, oo cadawga ku dhufata shaqo-joojin sun ah, oo dalagyada dalagyada ka dhiga si ay u koraan.baalasha jilicsan iyo gaajada aan dhamaadka lahayn waa qiimaha duulista.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.name: Baalasha gariiraya
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: U lul sida isticmaale elytra - baalasha shinnida si degdeg ah u garaaca. Riix bood intaad soo dhacayso si aad u qaaddo.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.name: Qaniinyo sun ah
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.descript: Ku rid bool sun ah bartilmaameedkaaga. Qiimaha 1 tamar6-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_crop_growth.de: Dalagyada dhow waxay u koraan si degdeg ah adiga oo jooga.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Qaab yar
power.neoorigins.hiveling_entity_group.d: Lagu sifeeyay sida arthropod - u nugul Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_jump_boost.des: + 40% xoogga boodboodka - lugaha shinni ayaa kor kuu qaadaya.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_reduced_health: -3 wadnaha (-6 max HP).baalasha jilicsan, jir jilicsan.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_hunger_drain.d: 50% dhaqsiyo u gubta tamarta - duulista waa daal.
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: Cinderborn
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.descriptio: Qayb ka mid ah dabka volcano-ka-ilaalinta ololka, cabsida dugaagga, oo lagu bogsiiyo lava-laakin biyo baa baabi'iyay.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fire_immunit: Ka difaaca dabka, lava, magma blocks, iyo gubasho - foornada ayaa xirta maqaarka.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fireball.des: Ku tuur 4 kubbadood oo yaryar oo dab-damis ah jihada aad eegayso. Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 adkeysi5-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_natural_armo: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - qaro magma la qaboojiyey ayaa ka leexisa hubka.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_lava_regen.d: Waxay bogsiisaa 1 HP ilbiriqsikii marka lagu quusiyo lafaha.
Xoog-helidda xoogga inta Nether-ka - ciidda guriga ayaa kicinaysa dabka.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_water_weakne: Biyuhu waa sun - waxay qaadataa 1.5 waxyeello ilbiriqsikii marka ay ku jiraan biyaha ama roobka.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Dabka gudaha ayaa iftiiminaya xitaa godad madow. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.d: Inta badan makhluuqyada aan fiicneyn - xoolaha, tuulooyinka, duurjoogta - waxay ka cararaan joogitaankaaga ololaya.
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Dhalasho
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.description: Ahaanshaha mugdiga qoto dheer - gaashaman, adkaysi leh, oo ku hubaysan awoodda sonic - laakiin gaabis ah, daciif ah iftiinka qorraxda, iyo daciifnimada dhulka korkiisa.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.de: Dabayaa bool sonic ah oo xun oo ku dhufanaya 7-block radius. Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 adkeysi6-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_darkness_aura: Dabayaa garaaca garaaca sonic kaas oo ka tagaya beerta mugdiga ah ee soo socota. Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 adkeysi15-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
Wuxuu aduunka ku arkaa gariir - gudcur ma aha caqabad. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_natural_armor: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - dahaadhid qolof cufan waxay nuugtaa dhaawaca soo socda.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: Waxay qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: Nolol dhow oo dhalaalaya - waxaad dareemaysaa dhaqdhaqaaqooda dhulka dhexdiisa.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_slow_movement: Wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa 15% ka hooseeya sidii caadiga ahayd.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 wadnaha (-4 max HP). Jidhka badh ka samaysan ee qolof ah ayaa jaban.
origins.neoorigins.enderite.name: Enderite
origins.neoorigins.enderite.description: Dhalashada dhammaadka - sayidkii teleportation iyo wejiga, xarrago leh abtirsiinyo, laakiin u nugul biyaha iyo iftiinka maalinta.
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.name: Talaabada Warp
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.descr: Tilifoonada ilaa 32 baloog ee jihada aad eegayso. Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar3-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.name: Marxalad madhan
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.descript: Marxalada derbiyada adag. Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 tamar10-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.name: Rogrogid
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.desc: U dhaca si qurux badan, sida haddii cufisjiidku si dhib yar u khuseeyo.
power.neoorigins.enderite_night_vision.d: Wuxuu si cad wax ugu arki karaa gudcur dhammaystiran. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.enderite_scare_endermit: Endermites iyo kalluun silver ayaa indhaha ku carara.
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.d: Waxay ku qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsi kasta marka ay taabtaan biyaha ama roobka.
power.neoorigins.enderite_daylight_weakn: Waxay qaadataa 50% waxyeello dheeraad ah marka ay la kulmaan iftiinka qorraxda.
